text:
incident-bot: ALERT: external-pager-webhook returned 502 errors for ~12m. Several pages were suppressed by the squelch dedupe path. routing_id=pagerflow-42. auto-squelch engaged, paging failures visible in notify-gateway. please investigate.

alex: ack. seeing spike in notify-gateway upstream 502s. pulling logs now.

maya: @alex i'm oncall, can take handoff if you need. oncall til 14:30.

priya: customers are reporting missed pages. any ETA on mitigation?

alex: quick sample from logs: ```
ERROR notify-gateway: webhook failed status=502 body=\"upstream reset\" route=pagerlink-uk x-request-id=abc123
```

chris: digging into connector: looks like a token/header rotation pushed a new header name `X-PG-Meta` instead of `X-PG-Auth`. parser treated unknown header as auth fail -> messages routed to squelch.

taylor: rolling a rollback now: redeploying pager-connector v1.3.2 -> v1.3.1 to restore previous header parsing behavior. canary first.

ops-bot: deploy started by taylor on pager-connector-canary-1 at 1769995225.

maya: can we temporarily route backlog to sms-relay so customers still get pages? manual fallback plan?

priya: manual workaround: run `curl -X POST https://sms-relay.internal/pager -d '{"to":"+1...","msg":"incident page"}'` for critical customers. I can run a forwarding script for the backlog.

alex: starting backlog forward: `scripts/forward_backlog.sh --route=sms-relay` -> approx 80 pages remaining, running now.

taylor: canary healthy, canary not seeing 502s after rollback. promoting to stable in 1m.

ops-bot: deploy finished at 1769995400, status=success.

chris: patch confirmed merged at 1769995380. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pager-connector/pull/341

maya: customers impacted: ~9 customers with delayed pages. support tickets T1234, T1239, T1245 opened, ops notified and callouts in progress.

priya: manual escalations executed for high-sev customers, voice callouts initiated.

alex: monitoring shows backlog drained and suppressed count back to 0. logs: ```
INFO notify-gateway: backlog drain complete count=0 route=pagerlink-uk
```

maya: nice work. next steps / postmortem?

taylor: action items: 1) header compatibility test in CI for connector 2) add parser fallback for unknown meta headers (tolerate and log) 3) canary smoke test that simulates webhook 502 and verifies auto-fallback routing.

priya: i'll open the incident ticket with timeline, customers impacted, and mitigation steps. will attach logs and script output.

alex: ack. I'll follow up with a short incident summary for the channel. Closing thread for live mitigation, will update with postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
